_comment: The dishes the site can show. The live site has no menu, so there are no prices: `price` stays null until the owner sends the menu. Descriptions say only what the photo or the live text shows. `onMenu` is "unconfirmed" for dishes known only from the supplied photos. Portuguese dish names stay as written in every language; generic names are translated.
